mannerisms: finishes meals before anyone else has noticed they began
pauses three beats before answering anything difficult
will not say a name they have not earned
voice: precise as cut glass and just as hard to argue with

fear: a life that adds up to nothing in particular

wound: a decade given to the wrong thing

backstory.origin: Marek was born in The Spire, of the Watchspires, the unwanted child of a ferryman and a translator.
backstory.weight: No single hardship marked their ancestry. The line behind them was ordinary and largely unbroken — which, they will sometimes admit, is its own kind of inheritance.
backstory.fracture: Around thirty, Marek sat down with the family papers and did not get up the same person. There was nobody else who would do this work, and so they did it, and so they became it.
backstory.between: The years that followed were not as remarkable as either the beginning or the present. Marek took a clerk's post, lost it, took the night shift at a glassworks, kept it longer than they expected. There was a season of silence that nobody who knew them then forgets.
backstory.present: Now, Marek works in a trade older than the city, lives in rooms they keep neat enough that no one would know how few possessions they own, and spends most of their evenings walking the same route. They are, by their own measure, closer to finished than to beginning.
